criteria.title: AISC S2 fixture regressions (D/E/F/G/H)
criteria.observation: Published Design Examples digits match clause modules for tension, compression, continuously braced flexure and shear. H1 is formula-checked against published φ capacities only (not section-derived LTB).

criteria.title: Screen 04 standalone pass/fail complete-member matrix
criteria.observation: UI seed selector runs ≥3 pass and ≥3 fail complete-member cases through evaluateDesign with overall status.

criteria.title: Model-derived demand and calculation-report clause trail
criteria.observation: Analysis midspan actions overlay a W seed; exported report includes clause trail and intermediates (not envelope maxima).

limitations: M07 packages AISC 360-22 LRFD S2 only. LTB (Lb>0), HSS/torsion/non-prismatic remain unsupported. Commercial PROKON parity remains UNKNOWN.
